title: GBA Fire Emblem message strings (text/<lang>/messages.json)
description: Every gMsgTable string as tagged text (gbafe.text.MessageCodec): characters are printable ASCII or Latin-1; control codes are {Name} tags from the decomp's texts/textdefs.txt ({NL}, {A}, {LoadFace FID_Eirika}, ...); bytes without a name are {0xNN ...}. Position in 'entries' = message id.

game.description: Game whose ROM the text was extracted from (docs/decisions/0010-multi-game-reuse.md).

text.description: Tagged text without the terminator. Literal braces never appear outside tags.
